name: Linear
description: Step kinds `linear.fetch` (resolve a ticket via the Linear GraphQL API and emit it as a structured Ticket payload), `linear.split` (project a Ticket into title + description Markdown), `linear.set-status` (move a ticket to a new workflow state given as a string), `linear.comment` (post a Markdown comment in a ticket's native comment thread and re-emit the updated Ticket) and `linear.triage.fetch` (list the N most recent tickets in the Triage state as a JSON array, with each ticket's description images downloaded as base64). Publishes the `plugin:linear:Ticket@v1` artifact kind consumed by downstream steps.
author: CtxFirst team
